config.scope: Conditional stationary-Gaussian reference distributions for the already observed center/outer MAD ratios; no new galaxy motion or gravity score.
config.spatial_contract: Use the actual native dimensions and pixel size. Apply the previously replayed extra Gaussian and 8x8 block average as a finite linear operator. The second surrogate first filters independent native pixels with a circular Gaussian whose FWHM is the recorded native major beam. This is a sensitivity model, not a measured interferometer covariance or a recovered dirty beam.
config.spectral_contract: Propagate each surrogate parent spectral covariance through the recovered polynomial continuum-subtraction operator A C A^T, then restrict to the same retained historical continuum-fit candidate channels. Normalize marginal channel variances because each channel MAD ratio is invariant to scale. No actual visibility covariance is claimed.
config.sampler: Sample the separable Gaussian directly on the coarse grid using exact finite-operator spatial covariance and selected-channel covariance. Verify against the native linear transformation on small grids and bound float32-rounding differences. This avoids generating discarded native pixels for every replicate.
statistics: Per-galaxy median of channel center/outer MAD ratios
Mean log of those galaxy-level ratios across all eight galaxies
config.tail_summary: Report (1 + number of reference draws at least as large as the observed statistic)/(replicates+1). This is an exploratory conditional reference fraction, not a calibrated observational or gravity p-value. Preserve all four surrogate branches.
config.exposure: All observed ratios were examined before this protocol. This diagnoses a development-data issue and is not independent confirmation.
nonclaims: Gaussian stationary surrogates do not reconstruct the actual visibility sampling or nonstationary noise
A tail discrepancy does not identify faint gas, continuum residuals or other instrumental structure as its cause
Spatial-surrogate variation is not an observational uncertainty posterior
No selection mask or full cube likelihood is admitted by this experiment
